On what a word means, the Indian schools differ. The Mīmāṃsakas hold that a word primarily signifies the **universal** (jāti, the class character). Advaita Vedanta follows the Mīmāṃsā view in this matter, so for Vedantins a word primarily means the class character of individuals (option (D) is correct).

Old Nyāya holds that a word means the individual, the form and the universal together, not the universal only, so option (C) is wrong. So the answer is option (D).
